_about: Seed retrieval test set for DHARA. Each question is written the way a citizen would ask it (not copied from section headings). 'expected' lists sections that count as a correct answer: a question is a HIT at k if ANY listed section is in the top k results. Every expected section was verified to exist (and to be non-repealed) in corpus_seed/legal_sections.jsonl.gz by tests/test_retrieval_eval.py. LIMITATIONS: written by an AI assistant, not reviewed by a lawyer; 50 English questions only; scope is the CENTRAL corpus. Please have the team add real user questions and have a legal reviewer confirm the expected sections before using these numbers for any claim about answer quality.
